claims.claim: Known scalar diagonal-load controls and coherent rectangular transfer measurements determine all finite accessible load-task values modulo a diagonal hidden-coordinate gauge under explicit pair-observability and invertibility assumptions.
assumptions: Fixed qualified one-coordinate linear loading family
Calibrated fixed source/readout gains and loading
Full-rank forward columns and reverse rows for every control pair
claims.cost: 1+2m+choose(m,2) load settings; two sources and two outputs suffice under the stated pair conditions; repeats/calibration/settling are additional.
claims.prior_boundary: Virtual VNA3 Eq25 and Steps2-4 already contain the scaling equivalence. No broad novelty claim.

claims.claim: All diagonal-load accessible transfer data can agree for a reciprocal and a nonreciprocal strictly accretive plant; hidden reciprocity cannot be certified from this entire experiment class.
claims.finite_check: Exact arbitrary-load similarity identity and strict diagonal dominance in verification.json
claims.scope: Task values remain identical; known coupled loads can break the diagonal gauge. Not a universal impossibility for other experiment classes.

claims.claim: A load individually invisible at the reference can affect the output jointly with another load, even for a strictly accretive real plant.
claims.scope: Refutes treating a zero single-load response as universal irrelevance; not a generic acquisition lower bound.
